correctness.rationale: Using standard unit-\(L^2\)-normalized degree-two harmonics, every off-diagonal column inner product is an m-point geometric sum with nonzero azimuth difference of absolute value at most four, hence vanishes for m>=5. Exactly computed column norms give the full multiplicity spectrum. The only interior zero comes from 3h^2-1=0. Four analytic height regions prove the unique optimum (6-sqrt(21))/15 and squared bound (5+sqrt21)/4. The supplied standard-library checker made 180 full Gram comparisons and tested 9999 heights; no numerical result is used as a proof of the universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: A mirrored pair of equal-resolution latitude rings is a natural low-complexity quadrupolar sensor architecture. Its full frame spectrum, complete loss-of-rank latitude, and unique best latitude are natural exact design invariants. The phase and number-of-sensors independence means the same exact prescription applies to arbitrarily many ring sensors. This is not only a finite example or a numerical improvement: it solves a continuum minimax problem exactly within the natural sampling family.
